scripts.dev: bash -lc 'source ../../scripts/lib/source-env.sh; source_env_if_allowed ../../.env; port=${WEB_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}}; ../../scripts/dev/kill-stale-service.sh web; exec next dev --webpack -p "${port}"'
scripts.e2e:build: bash -lc 'source ../../scripts/lib/source-env.sh; source_env_if_allowed ../../.env; export NODE_ENV=production; export NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:${API_PORT:-4000}}"; exec next build --webpack'
scripts.e2e:serve: bash -lc 'source ../../scripts/lib/source-env.sh; source_env_if_allowed ../../.env; export NODE_ENV=production; export NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:${API_PORT:-4000}}"; exec next start -p "${WEB_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}}"'
scripts.test:e2e: bash -lc 'source ../../scripts/lib/source-env.sh; source_env_if_allowed ../../.env; E2E_WALL_CLOCK_BUDGET_SECONDS=120; if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec timeout --kill-after=10 "${E2E_WALL_CLOCK_BUDGET_SECONDS}" pnpm exec playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts; elif command -v gtimeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec gtimeout --kill-after=10 "${E2E_WALL_CLOCK_BUDGET_SECONDS}" pnpm exec playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts; else exec node ../../scripts/e2e/wall-clock-watchdog.mjs "${E2E_WALL_CLOCK_BUDGET_SECONDS}" pnpm exec playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts; fi'
